title: 第8章 婴儿苏醒

content_zh:
一时间无人做声，火车上一般只有乘警，哪里会有医生，而且火车拥挤，乘警一时半会也过不来，这两个孩子虽然还有呼吸，但是脸色并不好，谁知道这两个孩子被闷了多久。
“怎么办怎么办……”女孩子着急的眼泪在眼眶中打转。
许多人沉默下来，这是两个幼小的生命，即便是陌路人，也不忍看到两个幼小的生命就这样离开人世。
展步一看孩子情况不对，急忙喊道：“别愣着，这节车厢没有医生，可能别的车厢有医生，你，往前面的车厢走，喊一下看有没有医生在火车上，你往后面走……”
被展步点到的人急忙行动，过道上的人急忙为他们让路，这是一个生命的接力，在这种时刻，无论是谁，都会尽可能的伸出自己的援手。
不大一会，一个戴着眼镜的中年男医生急匆匆的走来：“我是医生，都让一下，孩子在哪里？”
“这边！”女孩站起来焦急的喊道。
中年医生经过那中年妇女身边的时候，面带鄙夷的望了这女人一眼，因为这女人被展步踢倒在地上，这医生也不知道是故意还是无意，一脚踩在这中年妇女的手上，碾了过去。
医生随手拿出一个听诊器仔细给孩子检查，然后翻了翻孩子的眼皮，有些凝重的说道：“是中度缺氧。”
“危险吗？”女孩焦急的问道。
医生点了点头：“已经到达浅度昏迷了，这种情况很不好，现在就怕呼吸暂停，不能让孩子一直昏迷下去，否则会有生命危险。”
“那怎么办？”
医生看了一眼周围，然后对中年大叔说道：“你抱着这个孩子，我抱另一个孩子，跟着我的动作学，现在只能帮助孩子运动，刺激孩子的反射运动，只要醒了，命就保住了！”
车厢里静悄悄，所有人都注视着这两个抱着婴儿的男人，大气不敢喘，生怕自己的呼吸会影响到两人。
一分钟……
二分钟……
五分钟……
此时，医生与中年大叔额头上全是汗水，两个孩子丝毫没有转醒的迹象，所有人的心都提到了嗓子眼，期待奇迹的来临。
医生这时候焦急的说道：“不行，孩子缺氧太过严重，简单的运动已经没有多大用了，必须到医院用正规的医疗器材才行，下一站还有多长时间？”
“大概需要半小时。”有人答道。

医生焦急的看着怀中的孩子，此时这孩子已经面色发青，呼吸微弱：“半个小时？现在这孩子一刻都耽误不了啊。”
中年大叔此时惊呼道：“医生快看，这孩子好像不会呼吸了，需要人工呼吸吗？”
医生刚刚想说话，此时展步脑子里灵光一闪，他指了指那焦急的女孩：“不，大叔你把孩子给她抱一下，两个孩子都给她抱着。”
不少人被展步无厘头的提议弄的一愣，不知道展步究竟打的什么主意。
医生皱了皱眉：“其实中度缺氧已经影响到了中枢神经，人工呼吸作用也不大，换个人抱，也无济于事。”
展步来不及解释，大声吼道：“快啊，给她抱着，晚了就来不及了，相信我！”
女孩不知道展步葫芦里卖的什么药，不过出于对展步的信任，还是伸出个胳膊，医生和中年大叔都把孩子递给了这个女孩。
此时那中年女人知道完了，瘫坐在地上六神无主。展步也懒得管她，他松开了中年妇女的手，来到女孩身边，将两个小家伙的头分别调整了一下位置，仿佛孩子吃奶一般。
女孩此时羞红了脸，她又没生过孩子，做出给孩子喂奶的动作，的确很难为情。
中年医生此时点点头：“母爱是这个世界上最伟大的奇迹，用母爱来唤醒孩子，的确是最可行的方法！”
听到中年医生的解释，不少人恍然大悟。
女孩听到医生的话，顿时觉得心里仿佛有一种沉甸甸的东西，她下意识的抱紧了两个孩子，仿佛怕下一刻就失去他们一般。
女孩看着两个脸色发青的孩子，微微低了低头，轻轻吻在他们的额头。
紧接着，两个孩子仿佛感受到了什么，小小的脑袋竟然微微一拱，女孩以为是自己的错觉，她忍不住低头仔细看两个小家伙。
“我好像看到两个小家伙动了一下。”中年大叔忽然开心的说道。

content_en:
No one said a word for a while. There were usually only police officers on the train, and there was no doctor anywhere. Moreover, the train was crowded, and the police officers would not be able to get through for a while. Although the two children were still breathing, their faces were not good. Who knows how long these two children had been suffocated.
"What should I do, what should I do..." The girl's anxious tears welled up in her eyes.
Many people fell silent. These were two young lives. Even strangers could not bear to see two young lives pass away like this.
Zhan Bu saw something was wrong with the child and hurriedly shouted: "Don't be stunned. There is no doctor in this carriage. There may be doctors in other carriages. Go to the front carriage and shout to see if there is a doctor on the train. Go to the back..."
The people who were clicked by Zhanbu hurriedly acted, and the people in the aisle hurriedly made way for them. This was a relay of life. At this moment, no matter who it was, they would try their best to lend a helping hand.
After a while, a middle-aged male doctor wearing glasses hurriedly walked over: "I am a doctor, please step aside, where is the child?"
"This way!" the girl stood up and shouted anxiously.
When the middle-aged doctor passed by the middle-aged woman, he looked at the woman with contempt, because the woman was kicked to the ground by Zhanbu. The doctor didn't know whether it was intentional or unintentional, but he stepped on the middle-aged woman's hand and ran her over.
The doctor casually took out a stethoscope and examined the child carefully, then rolled the child's eyelids and said solemnly: "It's moderate hypoxia."
"Is it dangerous?" the girl asked anxiously.
The doctor nodded: "We have reached a shallow coma. This situation is very bad. Now we are afraid of apnea. We cannot let the child remain in a coma, otherwise his life will be in danger."
"What should we do?"
The doctor took a look around, and then said to the middle-aged uncle: "You hold this child, and I will hold the other child, and follow my movements. Now you can only help the child move and stimulate the child's reflex movements. As long as he wakes up, his life will be saved!"
The carriage was quiet, and everyone was staring at the two men holding babies. They didn't dare to breathe for fear that their breathing would affect the two of them.
One minute...
Two minutes...
five minutes...
At this time, the doctor and the middle-aged uncle were covered with sweat on their foreheads, and the two children showed no signs of waking up. Everyone's hearts were in their throats, expecting a miracle to come.
The doctor said anxiously at this time: "No, the child's hypoxia is too severe. Simple exercise is no longer of much use. We must go to the hospital to use regular medical equipment. How long will it take for the next stop?"
"It will take about half an hour," someone replied.
The doctor looked anxiously at the child in his arms. At this time, the child's face was blue and his breathing was weak: "Half an hour? This child can't waste a moment now."
The middle-aged uncle exclaimed at this time: "Doctor, look quickly, this child seems to be unable to breathe. Does he need artificial respiration?"
The doctor was just about to speak when an idea flashed in Zhan Bu's mind. He pointed at the anxious girl: "No, uncle, give her the child to hold. Hold both children."
Many people were stunned by Zhan Bu's nonsensical suggestion and wondered what Zhan Bu had in mind.
The doctor frowned: "Actually, moderate hypoxia has affected the central nervous system, and artificial respiration is not very effective. Trying to find someone else to hold her will not help."
Zhan Bu didn't have time to explain, so he shouted loudly: "Hurry up and hold her. If it's too late, it'll be too late. Trust me!"
The girl didn't know what kind of medicine was sold in Zhanbu's gourd, but out of trust in Zhanbu, she still extended her arm. Both the doctor and the middle-aged uncle handed the child to the girl.
At this time, the middle-aged woman knew it was over and collapsed on the ground, lost in thought. Zhan Bu didn't bother to care about her. He let go of the middle-aged woman's hand, came to the girl's side, and put the two little guys together.Her head adjusted its position, as if a child was sucking milk.
The girl's face turned red with embarrassment. She had never given birth to a child, so it was really embarrassing for her to breastfeed her child.
The middle-aged doctor nodded at this time: "Mother's love is the greatest miracle in the world. Using mother's love to awaken children is indeed the most feasible way!"
After hearing the middle-aged doctor's explanation, many people suddenly realized.
When the girl heard the doctor's words, she suddenly felt something heavy in her heart. She subconsciously hugged the two children tightly, as if she was afraid of losing them in the next moment.
The girl looked at the two blue-faced children, lowered her head slightly, and kissed their foreheads gently.
Immediately afterwards, the two children seemed to feel something, and their little heads arched slightly. The girl thought it was her imagination, and she couldn't help but lower her head to take a closer look at the two little guys.
"I think I saw the two little guys moving." The middle-aged uncle suddenly said happily.
